top_signals.title: FTSE 100 Live: Burberry leads modest open as Asian tech steadies after rout
top_signals.summary: Welcome back to City AM‘s FTSE 100 live blog. top_signals.title: Omoto: Can Tap Alternative LNG Amid Mideast Disruptions
top_signals.summary: Geopolitics is top of mind at Bloomberg’s New Economy Forum with escalating tensions in the Middle East. One of Japan’s top trading houses explained the impact of the war on their businesses around the world. Masayuki Omoto, President & CEO of Marubeni spoke to Bloomberg’s Shery Ahn on the sidelines of the Bloomberg New Economy Forum in New Delhi. (Source: Bloomberg)
